# Auto-generated standalone model file
import numpy as np
import scipy.special
from tvb.basic.neotraits.api import Attr, Final, List, NArray, Range
from tvb.simulator.models.base import Model


class Hopfield(Model):

    tauT = NArray(
        label=r":math:`tauT`",
        default=np.array([5.0]),
        domain=Range(lo=0.01, hi=100.0, step=0.01),
        doc="""The slow time-scale for threshold calculus :math:`\\theta`, state-variable of the model""",
    )
    taux = NArray(
        label=r":math:`taux`",
        default=np.array([1.0]),
        domain=Range(lo=0.01, hi=100.0, step=0.01),
        doc="""The fast time-scale for potential calculus :math:`x`, state-variable of the model""",
    )
    dynamic = NArray(
        label=r":math:`dynamic`",
        default=np.array([0.0]),
        doc="""Threshold dynamics: 0 (default) -> theta tracks x (TVB display hack); >0 -> theta relaxes to its own coupling input.""",
    )

    _nvar = 2
    state_variables = ["theta", "x"]

    state_variable_range = Final(
        label="State Variable ranges [lo, hi]",
        default={"theta": np.array([0.0, 1.0]), "x": np.array([-1.0, 2.0])},
        doc="""Expected ranges of the state variables for initial condition generation and phase plane setup.""",
    )

    variables_of_interest = List(
        of=str,
        label="Variables watched by Monitors",
        choices=("theta", "x"),
        default=("theta", "x"),
        doc="""Default state variables to be monitored.""",
    )

    parameter_names = List(
        of=str,
        label="List of parameters for this model",
        default=["tauT", "taux", "dynamic"],
    )

    local_parameter_names = []

    state_variable_dfuns = Final(
        label="Drift functions",
        default={
            "theta": "np.where(np.greater(dynamic, 0), (c_glob1 - theta)/tauT, (c_glob0 - x)/taux)",
            "x": "(c_glob0 - x)/taux",
        },
    )

    cvar = np.array([0, 1], dtype=np.int32)

    coupling_terms = Final(label="Coupling terms", default=["c_glob0", "c_glob1"])

    _R = None
    _stimulus = 0.0
    use_numba = False

    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        theta = state_variables[0, :]
        x = state_variables[1, :]

        tauT = self.tauT
        taux = self.taux
        dynamic = self.dynamic

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)
        c_glob0 = coupling[0, :]
        c_glob1 = coupling[1, :]

        # Derived Variables

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray(
                np.where(
                    np.greater(dynamic, 0),
                    (c_glob1 - theta) / tauT,
                    (c_glob0 - x) / taux,
                )
            ),  # theta
            np.asarray((c_glob0 - x) / taux),  # x
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
